sahneler.metin: Deep underwater near Guam, a nuclear submarine hit a mountain.
Suddenly the crew was thrown forward, and one sailor later died.
It was running at flank speed.
The seamount wasn't on the chart in use.
Other charts showed signs of it.
The crew fought to surface with ruptured ballast tanks.
The Navy reviewed how chart hazards are shared.

aciklama:
USS San Francisco struck an undersea mountain near Guam. The cause: flank speed at depth in poorly charted waters, with warnings left off the working chart.

#shorts #engineering #maritime
